bullets.text: Public near Ambattur in Chennai demand road repairs and traffic fixes after a lorry hit and killed a girl, and the office should monitor local safety measures.
A sanitation worker died inside an Avadi Corporation sewage tank, and the office should watch police and municipal investigations into plant safety compliance.
The meteorological center warns of heavy rain in Chennai due to the Akvan cyclone, and the office should coordinate disaster preparedness across affected areas.
Residents of Pallikaranai and surrounding areas resolved to demand the removal of construction bans in wetlands, and the office should review this policy representation.
Police cybercrime units conducted inspections in Tiruvanmiyur Kamaraj Nagar, and the office should track ongoing cyber safety enforcement in the constituency.
Power supply will be suspended in parts of Velachery for maintenance work, and the office should ensure utilities complete the work on schedule.
Five officials were suspended over fake library book purchases in Thiruvallur, and the office should monitor the departmental inquiry and asset verification.
Public questioned why 153 unauthorized buildings in Puzhal union remain despite court orders, and the office should check enforcement actions by local authorities.
Slow canal work in Gummidipoondi led to sewage entering residential areas, and the office should direct the civic body to accelerate drainage clearance.
MeitY questioned home services platforms regarding video data collection from gig workers for AI training, and the office should track national data privacy compliance.
The Centre flagged governance gaps across AI and digital services in states, and the office should review institutional frameworks in Tamil Nadu.
High-tech cameras using AI technology were installed to monitor traffic violations on national highways, and the office should assess similar smart policing rollouts.
AirTrunk plans massive data center campuses in Andhra Pradesh, and the office should evaluate regional competition for data center investments in Tamil Nadu.
Andhra Pradesh pushed for sector-specific industrial parks at a partnership summit, and the office should watch industrial development trends for digital manufacturing.
